# cueloop

cueloop is a terminal-first review surface for coding agents. It opens agent work as a Thread, keeps comments attached to exact text, and returns a Message to the same agent conversation.

## When to use cueloop

Use cueloop when a coding agent should pause for a human review of a plan, reply, diff, prototype, or pull request. Use it to add line-level comments, approve work, ask for changes, or share a Thread with a teammate over SSH.

Do not use the public API to create or modify reviews. Review operations run through the cueloop CLI or a Claude Code, Codex, or pi integration.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://cueloop.dev/install.sh | sh
```
